title: Plumbix pipeline, format version 1
description: Schema for .plumbix/pipeline.yaml. Plumbix also enforces rules that span fields, which this schema cannot express: step names are unique; every name in needs refers to another existing step, appears once, and is not a validator step; needs contain no cycles; a secret name is not also an env key; timeout is above zero and at most 24h; allow_failure and when are not set on validator steps; external is set only on validator steps and such a step has no image, run, env, secrets or retries; every step named in stages exists, is not a validator and is in one stage only.

stages.description: Named groups of steps, for display and run evidence. A step is in at most one stage; validators are never in a stage.

varName.description: Environment variable or secret name. Names starting with PLUMBIX_ are reserved.

image.description: Container image the step runs in.

run.description: Shell script run with sh -c, or a list of commands run in order as one script that stops at the first failure. Required unless the step is a validator.

needs.description: Steps that must succeed before this one starts.

secrets.description: Names of secrets exposed to this step only, as environment variables.

artifacts.description: Workspace-relative paths kept as evidence after the step.

validator.description: Marks a validator step, which receives validator inputs and must write a verdict.

retries.description: How many more times a failed or timed-out step is run. Only the last attempt counts.

allow_failure.description: A failed or timed-out step does not fail the run and does not skip the steps that need it. Not for validators.

external.description: The validator's verdict comes from a reviewer outside the pipeline: Plumbix publishes a review brief and waits, bounded by timeout (default one hour). Only for validators; no image, run, env, secrets or retries.

when.description: Run condition. For a change's run the step runs only if a changed file matches one of the globs; a plain branch run always runs it. Not for validators.

items.description: Relative glob; * and ? match within a segment, ** matches any number of segments.
